texts.name: Melina
texts.biography: Strangely, few Medusas obtain the title of Overlord, but Melina achieved it through her great combat intelligence and ability to command the Medusas.

specialty.name: Medusas
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Medusas and Medusa Queens by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
